instruction: Please act as a professional verilog designer. Design a module that implements a 3-bit up/down counter with a load input. The module should have four inputs (clk, up_down, load, and reset) and one output (count). The up_down input determines whether the counter counts up or down on each clock cycle (up if up_down is high, down if up_down is low). The load input should load a new value into the counter on the next clock cycle. The reset input should reset the counter to zero on the next clock cycle. The module should count from 0 to 7 and then roll over to 0 if counting up, or count from 7 to 0 and then roll over to 7 if counting down.
original_rtl:
module up_down_counter (
    input clk,
    input up_down,
    input load,
    input reset,
    output reg [2:0] count
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            count <= 3'b0;
        end
        else if (load) begin
            count <= 3'b0;
        end
        else if (up_down) begin
            if (count == 3'b111) begin
                count <= 3'b0;
            end
            else begin
                count <= count + 1;
            end
        end
        else begin
            if (count == 3'b000) begin
                count <= 3'b111;
            end
            else begin
                count <= count - 1;
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
